measures.name: Net Units YoY %
measures.expression:
VAR _first = CALCULATE ( MIN ( dim_date[date] ), ALL ( dim_date ) )
VAR _start = MIN ( dim_date[date] )
VAR _end   = MAX ( dim_date[date] )

-- Selection starts in the first year but runs beyond it (e.g. no slicer, or all years)
VAR _useLatestYTD = _start < EDATE ( _first, 12 ) && _end >= EDATE ( _first, 12 )

VAR _curStart  = IF ( _useLatestYTD, DATE ( YEAR ( _end ), 1, 1 ), _start )
VAR _prevStart = EDATE ( _curStart, -12 )

VAR _cur =
    IF (
        _useLatestYTD,
        CALCULATE (
            [Net Units],
            REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
            DATESBETWEEN ( dim_date[date], _curStart, _end )
        ),
        [Net Units]
    )

VAR _prev =
    IF (
        _useLatestYTD,
        CALCULATE (
            [Net Units],
            REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
            DATESBETWEEN ( dim_date[date], _prevStart, EDATE ( _end, -12 ) )
        ),
        CALCULATE ( [Net Units], DATEADD ( dim_date[date], -1, YEAR ) )
    )

RETURN
    IF ( _prevStart < _first, BLANK (), DIVIDE ( _cur - _prev, _prev ) )

measures.name: YoY Delta Text
measures.expression:
VAR v = [Net Units YoY %]
RETURN
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( v ),
        "No prior year",
        IF ( v >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( ABS ( v ), "0.0%" )
    )

measures.name: YoY Delta Fill
measures.expression:
VAR v = [Net Units YoY %]
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        ISBLANK ( v ), "#EBEBEB",
        v >= 0, "#9FD89F",
        "#EEACB2"
    )
